effect: Which connectors may run: slack, google (Gmail and Google Calendar), imap (Outlook included), caldav, jira (Confluence included), linear. A source left out stops syncing and keeps its data.
Whether the iPhone companion may sync: allowed, workbench_only (workbench data only) or off.
Which Quick Connections (MCP servers) may be added and used: https:// URL prefixes and absolute command paths.
Whether automations may run shell commands.
Which AI providers may be used: claude, codex, ollama. A forbidden provider is never a fallback.
Whether the chat may offer claude.ai publishing and connectors.

default: not set: the person's own setting
effect: Whether an account whose access was revoked has its data wiped.

Hours of notice before a revoked or removed account's data is deleted, 0 to 720; 0 deletes it after a later sync, unless that sync proves access. For an account not reached for 30 days the warning still comes 72 hours before the 30-day mark, and the data goes at the mark or this many hours after the warning, whichever is later. A value outside the range or not a whole number is ignored.

default: not set: each person is asked
effect: true is the organization's consent to AI that runs in the background, so people are not asked; each person can still pause it. false keeps background AI off and locks the switch.

The company's own Slack apps, one entry per workspace with team_id (T…) and client_id. Connections → Slack offers a one-press Connect for each; it never connects anyone. A malformed or duplicate entry is dropped.

The company bundle (the same code a company link carries): the company's app for every connector and its link deny list. Shows Connect all without a link; wins over a stored bundle of the same company and never deletes accounts.
Whether Jira may be connected with an Atlassian API token. false hides the option; token accounts stop syncing and keep their data.

Whether a person may connect Google through their own Google Cloud project. false hides and refuses the option; accounts on an own project (also one added earlier with a custom OAuth client) stop syncing and keep their data, company and shared-client accounts are untouched.
